[97] Chuyu Wang, Lei Xie, Yuancan Lin, Wei Wang, Yingying Chen, Yanling Bu, Kai
Zhang, and Sanglu Lu. 2021. Thru-the-wall Eavesdropping on Loudspeakers
via RFID by Capturing Sub-mm Level Vibration. Proceedings of the ACM on
Interactive, Mobile, Wearable and Ubiquitous Technologies 5, 4 (2021), 1–25.
Large-scale Text-to-Image Generation Models for Visual Artists’ Creative Works IUI ’23, March 27–31, 2023, Sydney, NSW, Australia
paper_level_summary_zh: 该引用论文在参考文献中列出目标论文，但正文中未引用该论文。目标论文属于RFID感知领域，而引用论文主要研究文本到图像生成模型，因此目标论文仅作为参考文献条目存在，没有实质性讨论。
